arguments.message:
Make `Symbol('m', even=True).is_finite` return True.

Root cause: even/odd were defined only via `even == integer & !odd` (and integer chains to finite), but `is_finite` was never asked to infer from an established `even`/`odd` value in a forward-only way. Naively adding `even -> finite` to FactRules fixes the symbol case but also creates the contrapositive `!finite -> !even`, which wrongly forces `oo.is_even`/`oo.is_odd` (and `mm` equivalents) to False instead of None.

Fix: in `sympy/core/assumptions.py::_ask`, after the normal handler/prerequisite evaluation, add a one-way implication — when asking about `finite` and `even` or `odd` is already known True, deduce `finite=True`. This infers finiteness from even/odd without allowing the reverse `!finite -> !even` deduction, so `oo.is_even is None` and `mm.is_even is None` are preserved.

Verified: sympy/core/tests/test_assumptions.py — 66 passed, 0 failed (includes both the `Symbol('m', even=True).is_finite is True` expectation and the `oo.is_even is None` / `mm.is_even is None` regression guards).

Deliver patch-1 (version v11). Fix: in sympy/core/assumptions.py::_ask, added a one-way implication so that asking for `finite` while `even`/`odd` is already True deduces `finite=True`. Implemented outside FactRules deliberately to avoid the contrapositive `!finite -> !even`, which would wrongly set `oo.is_even`/`oo.is_odd`/`mm.is_even` to False. Public test evidence (sequence 72, v11): sympy/core/tests/test_assumptions.py — 66 passed, 0 failed, 3 xfailed; passed=true. Covers both `Symbol('m', even=True).is_finite is True` and the `oo.is_even is None`/`mm.is_even is None` regression guards.

from sympy import Symbol, oo, zoo, nan, S, Integer, Rational

m = Symbol('m', even=True)
print("m.is_finite =", m.is_finite)
assert m.is_finite is True, m.is_finite

k = Symbol('k', odd=True)
print("k.is_finite =", k.is_finite)
assert k.is_finite is True, k.is_finite

i = Symbol('i', integer=True)
print("i.is_finite =", i.is_finite)

# Regression guards: must remain None
print("oo.is_even =", oo.is_even, "oo.is_odd =", oo.is_odd)
assert oo.is_even is None
assert oo.is_odd is None
mm = -oo
print("mm.is_even =", mm.is_even, "mm.is_odd =", mm.is_odd)
assert mm.is_even is None
assert mm.is_odd is None
print("zoo.is_even =", zoo.is_even, "zoo.is_odd =", zoo.is_odd)
print("nan.is_even =", nan.is_even, "nan.is_odd =", nan.is_odd)

# Concrete integers still finite
print("Integer(2).is_finite =", Integer(2).is_finite)
assert Integer(2).is_finite is True
print("Rational(1,2).is_finite =", Rational(1, 2).is_finite)
assert Rational(1, 2).is_finite is True

# even symbol still reports even/odd/integer consistently
print("m.is_even=", m.is_even, "m.is_odd=", m.is_odd, "m.is_integer=", m.is_integer)
assert m.is_even is True
assert m.is_odd is False
assert m.is_integer is True

print("ALL OK")
